title: Bi-Lipschitz coordinates at regular RCD points
exact_target: For each $n\geq 2$, is there L(n) such that any point p of a noncollapsed RCD(K,n) space $(X,d,H^{n}_d)$, whose every pointed tangent is Euclidean $R^{n}$, has an ambient-open neighborhood bi-Lipschitz homeomorphic with constant L(n) to an open Euclidean set? The chart uses the restricted ambient metric, and L(n) is independent of K and the space.
